UN Human Rights Chief Alarmed by Rise in Iran Executions

UN Human Rights Chief Volker Türk has expressed alarm over an increase in executions in Iran since March. He stated that 56 people have been executed on charges related to national security. Of these, 27 executions were linked to protests that occurred in January. Türk indicated that Iran is using executions to suppress dissent.
